notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
-Added a delay for skipping dialogue scenes to prevent accidental skips.
-Adjusted enemy stopping distance to player to prevent the enemies from pushing the player out of the map.
-Fixed a bug where reloading save files repeatedly would give the player all weapons, but the weapon pickups would remain and break the game if the player picked that weapon up.
-Weapons now require the player to press the "Interact" button to pick them up, preventing the player from accidentally picking up weapons and ruining progress on the "Batter Up" achievement.

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Added Steam Achievements:[/b]

-[b]"Call Me Daddy"[/b]
Unlocked when completing the game.
-[b]"Explorer"[/b]
Unlocked when all runes have been collected.
-[b]"Batter Up!"[/b]
Unlocked when game is completed with just the baseball bat in inventory.
-[b]"Leave No Survivors"[/b]
Unlocked when game is completed and all enemies were slain.
-[b]"Survivor"[/b]
Unlocked when game is completed and the player never died.
-[b]"Invincible!"[/b]
Unlocked when game is completed and the player never took damage.

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
-Player no longer sticks to objects.
-Dialogue Scenes are now skippable.
-Enemy hitboxes have been adjusted to be easier to hit.
-Spaced out cars so the player wouldn't get stuck between them.
-Sensitivity Slider has been revised and should work properly.
-Brightness slider has been added to the settings menu.
-Fixed issue where doors would close and and would no longer be interactable.
-Fixed animation issue when first picking up new weapons.
-Pressing the "Switch Weapons" Key or button while reloading a gun will stop the reload.
-Made adjustments to the terrain to help guide players.
